notes.title: A message from the Game Director
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

this is Alfred, the Game Director of Food Devils.
I wanted to thank you all for the warm enthusiasm and hype surrounding the game so far - here's some fantastic news: [b]Food Devils has just crossed 15,000 wishlists[/b]! ✨
This is a huge milestone for a game that only has a reveal trailer.

Looking back at last year's footage, and comparing it to our internal builds, I can already see how far the game has come and how much has changed since then. I'm incredibly excited to show you updated gameplay and footage over the next few months! Soon I will update the Steam page to reflect the current polish of the game.

We're also planning a public demo in the not-too-distant future, possibly by the end of 2025. But I won't make any promises on strict deadlines because my approach with Food Devils has been to avoid rushing things and to focus on delivering an indie game with top-notch audiovisual quality and fun, replayable gameplay. That takes time - so I hope you'll bear with us, and let us cook (in every sense of the word)! 🌶️

Once again, thank you for your support and your patience.
I wish you all a great day - I'll be back with another update as soon as we've got more cool stuff to show off.

Stay spicy,
-Alfred
